Germany : Choose the way you work best—either fully remote or hybrid from one of our offices in Berlin, Munich, or Cologne. You'll lead technical discovery, deliver tailored product demonstrations, validate technical requirements, and guide customers through security and procurement processes. Working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Product Marketing, you'll play a key role in winning complex enterprise opportunities and ensuring customers have confidence in our solution. Core Skills And Experience Enterprise pre-sales, Solutions Engineering, or a similar customer-facing technical role. Leading technical discovery and qualification using frameworks such as SPICED, MEDDIC, or similar methodologies. Delivering engaging, value-based product demonstrations tailored to customer needs. Enterprise identity and access management concepts, including SSO, SAML, SCIM, role-based access control, and user provisioning. APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS architectures. Security reviews, technical questionnaires, RFPs, and working with procurement and security teams throughout the buying process. Communicating confidently with both technical and executive stakeholders, including CISOs, security teams, procurement, data protection, and compliance teams. Collaborating effectively with Account Executives, Customer Success, Product, and Product Marketing. Professional fluency in both German and English, written and spoken. AI literacy We're looking for someone who is comfortable using AI as part of their day-to-day workflow. This includes: Using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini to support research, discovery preparation, proposal writing, and customer communication. Leveraging AI to improve productivity while maintaining sound technical judgement. A curiosity to explore new AI capabilities and incorporate them into pre-sales workflows. Experience with lightweight automation or scripting is a bonus and demonstrates a builder mindset. Nice to have Cybersecurity, Human Risk Management, Security Awareness Training, or Learning platforms. Enterprise SaaS or cybersecurity technologies. Regulatory frameworks such as NIS2, DORA, ISO 27001, or TISAX. Behavioural science or security awareness programmes. Selling into large, regulated organisations across the DACH region. Additional European languages. A hands-on, builder mentality with an interest in improving processes and creating technical solutions. What we offer* Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days, and parental leave support Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, corporate discounts Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups Tech equipment, referral bonuses, an individual development budget, dog-friendly HQ Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process. About Us At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence. Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us. If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

Notre ambition est claire : renforcer la sécurité, l’inclusion et la confiance , grâce à une technologie qui fonctionne dans les vraies conditions du terrain. Aujourd’hui, nous recherchons un(e) Country Launcher & Business Developer pour lancer et développer AxioTrack au Togo. Contexte du poste# Nous cherchons un profil entrepreneur, autonome et orienté résultats , capable de passer de la stratégie à l’action. Votre rôle : faire exister AxioTrack sur le terrain , structurer les opérations et générer rapidement de la croissance sur le marché togolais. 📍 Lieu : Togo 🧭 Rattachement : CEO & Founder Mission principale# Déployer Et Structurer AxioTrack Au Togo En Combinant Lancement Opérationnel, Développement Commercial Et Partenariats Stratégiques, Avec Un Objectif Simple 👉 croître vite, bien et durablement . Construire le business plan pays (objectifs, budget, prévisions) 🚀 Lancer les opérations (Country Launcher)# Sélectionner et coordonner les partenaires techniques et logistiques Mettre en place des process simples d’installation, de support et de maintenance Recruter, former et manager l’équipe locale (commerciaux, techniciens) Superviser la logistique : stock, installations, service après-vente 📈 Développer le business (BizDev)# Prospecter et qualifier des clients B2B (flottes, TPE, e-commerçants) et B2C Piloter tout le cycle de vente : prospection, négociation, closing Signer les premiers contrats structurants du marché 🤝 Construire des partenariats solides# Nouer des alliances avec assureurs, garages, sociétés de gardiennage, opérateurs et réseaux de distribution Animer ces partenariats et co-construire des offres simples et utiles 📣 Booster la visibilité locale# Adapter les supports de communication au marché togolais (site, réseaux sociaux) Organiser des événements, démos terrain et webinars pour accélérer l’adoption 📊 Suivre la performance# Piloter le P&L pays Suivre les indicateurs clés (chiffre d’affaires, modules installés, churn) Produire un reporting régulier, clair et orienté décision Profil recherché# 🎓 Expérience# 3 ans minimum en lancement de marché, développement commercial ou expansion Expérience en SaaS, IoT, télécoms ou services digitaux appréciée 🛠 Compétences clés# Analyse de marché et construction de business plan Prospection, négociation et closing B2B Pilotage opérationnel et management d’équipes ou de prestataires Négociation de contrats structurants Lecture financière et suivi budgétaire 🌟 Qualités personnelles# Esprit entrepreneurial et sens du résultat Leadership naturel, capacité à fédérer Très à l’aise sur le terrain et dans des environnements multiculturels Envie réelle d’avoir un impact positif en Afrique 🌐 Langues# Français et anglais courants Une langue locale est un vrai plus Conditions & avantages# Contrat : CDI (avec période d’essai) Rémunération : fixe compétitif et progressif + variable lié à la performance Localisation : basé au Togo, avec déplacements régionaux (télétravail partiel possible) Forte review_candidates.title: Office Manager – Chairman’s Office
review_candidates.description: Company Description Land Sterling is a leading global real estate solutions provider with a strong local presence across the Middle East, North Africa, and Europe. The company’s international team of accredited experts brings over 100 years of cumulative experience and operates from offices in Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Leeds, London, and Riyadh. Land Sterling delivers innovative, technology-led services that cover every dimension of real estate, supporting clients with robust insights and advisory. The company offers a comprehensive range of property consultancy services aligned with RICS, CIOB, and International Valuation Standards across multiple industries, providing a professional environment for career growth. Role Description The Office Manager – Chairman’s Office is a full-time, on-site role based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, responsible for managing the day-to-day operations of the Chairman’s office. The role includes organizing schedules and meetings, coordinating travel and logistics, handling correspondence, and maintaining accurate records and files. The Office Manager will oversee office administration, ensure efficient use and maintenance of office equipment, and support the Chairman in preparing presentations, reports, and meeting materials. The position involves managing visitor and stakeholder interactions, coordinating with internal departments, and maintaining a professional, confidential, and well-organized office environment. The Office Manager will also assist in implementing office policies and procedures to support smooth executive operations. We are seeking a highly professional, discreet, and proactive Office Manager – Chairman’s Office to manage the Chairman’s day-to-day operating environment and serve as a key coordination point between the Chairman and internal and external stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Manage and continuously priorities the Chairman’s calendar, meetings, commitments, and briefing requirements. Coordinate the day-to-day operations of the Chairman’s Office and track key actions and follow-ups. Manage complex domestic and international travel , including flights, accommodation, visas, transportation, and detailed itineraries. Coordinate VIP protocol, hospitality, official engagements, and international delegations. Draft and manage correspondence on behalf of the Chairman with the appropriate level of professionalism and discretion. Act as the primary point of contact and gatekeeper for the Chairman’s Office. Liaise with Board members, senior executives, government and diplomatic offices, clients, investors, advisers, and business partners. Maintain strict confidentiality and secure handling of sensitive information and documentation. Manage office expenses, vendors, invoices, and administrative requirements within approved budgets. Identify operational improvements and maintain effective SOPs for the Chairman’s Office. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, International Relations, Hospitality Management , or a related field. 5+ years of experience supporting a Chairman, CEO, Managing Director, Board member, or equivalent senior principal. Hands-on experience managing international executive travel and VIP protocol . Excellent calendar management, planning, prioritization, and follow-up skills. Strong executive judgment and ability to handle sensitive matters with complete discretion. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Fluent in English and Arabic , written and spoken. Advanced proficiency in MS Office and scheduling/document-management systems. Strong stakeholder management and cross-cultural communication skills. Ability to remain calm, composed, and solutions-focused in a fast-paced executive environment. What We’re Looking For A polished and highly organized professional with exceptional attention to detail, strong executive presence, sound judgment, and the ability to anticipate needs and resolve issues before they reach the Chairman. 📍 Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia 💼 Department: Office of the Chairman 🎯 Experience: 5+ years in senior executive support
